headline: Turning a technical packaging range into an export sales engine.
summary: A full product catalogue, brochures, 110 AI image prompts across 41 products, Google Business Profile content and a LinkedIn-led export outreach system for GI PackTech.
channels: Catalogue, LinkedIn, Meta, Google Business Profile, website
challenge: GI PackTech makes specialised industrial packaging — VCI films, vacuum laminates, machine covers, reactor liners and more. The products are technical, the buyers are international, and the material explaining what each product does and when to use it did not exist in a form a buyer could act on.
The brief was to explain a complex range clearly to overseas buyers and then run a structured export lead-generation push.

workstreams.title: Product catalogue
workstreams.text: A full catalogue with product explanations, applications, customisation options and sales guidance for each line — written so a buyer and a sales rep read the same page.

workstreams.title: Brochures
workstreams.text: Product-specific brochures, starting with a flexible reactor liner brochure PDF.

workstreams.title: AI imagery
workstreams.text: 110 AI image prompts across 41 products for catalogue and website use, plus website hero imagery — consistent product visuals without a 41-product photoshoot.

workstreams.title: Local SEO
workstreams.text: Google Business Profile content so domestic buyers searching for packaging suppliers find a complete, current profile.

workstreams.title: Export lead generation
workstreams.text: A 50-company LinkedIn outreach tracker with curated messages, a Meta and LinkedIn marketing playbook, and Sales Navigator-led outreach to named buyers.

results: Export enquiries, meetings booked, LinkedIn response rate and RFQs are published once confirmed from the outreach tracker.

meta.title: GI PackTech case study — export lead engine | gaa-tha
meta.description: How gaa-tha turned GI PackTech's technical packaging range into a catalogue, AI product imagery and a LinkedIn-led export lead-generation system.
